# Frozen baseline: dependencies resolved from somewhere other than pub.dev —
# git sources (git:<pkg>:<url>:PINNED), path sources (path:<pkg>:<path>),
# hosted packages from other registries (hosted:<pkg>:<url>), and
# dependency_overrides entries (override:<pubspec>:<pkg>). Generated by
# scripts/check_dependency_provenance.sh. The set may only SHRINK (growth fails
# CI vs origin/main). Every entry carries a trailing '# reason' naming either
# the tracking issue that owns its removal or the permanent condition that
# requires it.
#
# A git:<pkg>:<url>:MUTABLE entry can never be baselined — the guard rejects a
# movable git ref unconditionally. Issues: #3655 / #3363.
git:c2pa_flutter:https://github.com/guardianproject/c2pa-flutter.git:PINNED # permanent: pub.dev name belongs to an incompatible package; replacement requires a rename plus API migration
override:mobile/packages/nostr_sdk/pubspec.yaml:meta # noise: transitive pin to keep the analyzer stack resolvable
override:mobile/pubspec.yaml:app_device_integrity # defer: #6918 (local fork; divergence and removal condition in overrides/app_device_integrity-1.1.0/OVERRIDE.md)
override:mobile/pubspec.yaml:device_info_plus # defer: #3638 (held on 10.x until the app absorbs the 11.x platform-interface changes)
path:app_device_integrity:overrides/app_device_integrity-1.1.0 # defer: #6918 (same local fork, seen from the lockfile)
